courses.overview: 跨單元連結與比較練習

related.title: 船舶艙室防火分區
related.why: 比較兩個系統的負載、能源或資料介面，列出不可直接沿用的邊界條件。
related.whyEn: Compare load, energy or data interfaces and identify boundary conditions that cannot be transferred.
related.difference: 船體尺度、載荷條件、海況及驗證目的必須分別設定。
related.differenceEn: Vessel scale, load conditions, sea state and verification purpose require separate definitions.
practice: 各選一個教學算例，記下輸入、輸出與單位。
對照兩課的系統邊界，說明哪些假設不能沿用。
改變一個輸入，提出量測與失效判據來核對結果。
practiceEn: Choose one worked example from each course and record inputs, outputs and units.
Compare system boundaries and identify assumptions that cannot transfer.
Change one input and propose measurements and failure criteria to check the result.

courses.summary: 本專題以面壓速度與摩擦熱建立起點，接到潤滑油熱量帳的系統介面，最後用故障假說與排除紀錄整合證據。這是原創教學進程，不是假稱現場工程紀錄。
courses.summaryEn: Begin with Pressure-speed and friction heat, connect through Lubricant heat balance, then integrate evidence using Fault hypotheses and exclusion records. This is an original teaching progression, not a claimed field record.

history.title: 船用密封與軸承可靠度
history.text: 本專題以面壓速度與摩擦熱建立起點，接到潤滑油熱量帳的系統介面，最後用故障假說與排除紀錄整合證據。這是原創教學進程，不是假稱現場工程紀錄。
history.textEn: Begin with Pressure-speed and friction heat, connect through Lubricant heat balance, then integrate evidence using Fault hypotheses and exclusion records. This is an original teaching progression, not a claimed field record.

courses.connection: 以溫度、摩擦、振動與入水跡象建立密封軸承的多證據診斷。 在軸封與軸承狀態資料室依十個單元完成機制觀察、定量比較、量測驗證與故障診斷；各算例為獨立教學假設，完整保留資料來源與模型限制。
courses.connectionEn: Use temperature, friction, vibration and ingress evidence for seal/bearing diagnosis. Complete ten units of mechanisms, quantitative comparisons, measurement verification and diagnosis in the Seal/bearing condition-data laboratory. Examples are independent teaching assumptions with sources and model limitations retained.
